title: Sixth Mughal Emperor
summary: Aurangzeb Alamgir was the sixth Mughal emperor who ruled over nearly the entire Indian subcontinent for 49 years. His reign saw the Mughal Empire reach its greatest geographical extent, but also witnessed its gradual decline due to continuous wars and revolts.

events.title: Birth of Aurangzeb
events.description: Muhi-ud-Din Muhammad Aurangzeb was born on November 3, 1618 in Dahod, Gujarat. He was the third son of Emperor Shah Jahan and Mumtaz Mahal.

events.title: Viceroy of the Deccan
events.description: At the age of 18, Aurangzeb was appointed Viceroy of the Deccan by his father Shah Jahan, beginning his political and military career in southern India.

events.title: Siege of Golconda
events.description: Aurangzeb besieged the wealthy Golconda Fort but was recalled by Shah Jahan before he could capture it. He would return to conquer it decades later.

events.title: War of Succession
events.description: Aurangzeb defeated his brothers Dara Shukoh, Shah Shuja, and Murad Baksh in a bloody war of succession to claim the Mughal throne after imprisoning his father Shah Jahan.

events.title: Coronation as Emperor
events.description: Aurangzeb crowned himself Emperor with the title 'Alamgir' (World Seizer) at Delhi, beginning one of the longest reigns in Mughal history spanning nearly 49 years.

events.title: Meeting with Shivaji at Agra
events.description: Shivaji visited Aurangzeb's court at Agra expecting respectful treatment but was humiliated. Shivaji's subsequent dramatic escape from house arrest embarrassed the Mughal court.

events.title: Siege of Bijapur
events.description: Aurangzeb conquered the Adil Shahi dynasty's capital of Bijapur after a prolonged siege, absorbing the Bijapur Sultanate into the Mughal Empire.

events.title: Fall of Golconda
events.description: Aurangzeb finally conquered Golconda after an eight-month siege, ending the Qutb Shahi dynasty. The Mughal Empire now reached its maximum territorial extent.

events.title: Deccan Wars Against Marathas
events.description: Aurangzeb spent the last 25 years of his life in the Deccan fighting the Marathas in grueling campaigns that drained the empire's treasury and military strength.

events.title: Death at Ahmednagar
events.description: Aurangzeb died on March 3, 1707 at Ahmednagar at the age of 88. His death marked the beginning of the rapid decline of the Mughal Empire.
